tagline: Enzymatic production of nanocellulose from brewers' spent grain - turning 39 million tonnes a year of brewing waste into a high-value biomaterial.
tagline_zh: 以酵素從啤酒糟生產奈米纖維素——把每年 3,900 萬公噸的釀酒廢棄物變成高值生物材料。
summary: NanoBrew takes brewers' spent grain (BSG), which makes up about 85% of beer brewing waste by weight and is mostly landfilled or sold as cheap animal feed, and extracts nanocellulose from it enzymatically instead of with hot acid and energy-intensive mechanical grinding. The team expressed a Bacillus subtilis xylanase (XynA) to strip hemicellulose and open up the cellulose, plus an ancestrally reconstructed Cel5A endoglucanase fused to a carbohydrate binding module to cut cellulose down to nanofibrils, and tested six construct variants with and without the YebF secretion tag in E. coli. It was Top 10 and nominated for Presentation, Entrepreneurship and Biomanufacturing because the project is framed end to end as a New Zealand circular-economy story - built on a real brewery partnership, grounded in the Maori value of kaitiakitanga, with a full pilot-plant cost analysis and letters of support - and because the team is candid that it never managed to characterise its product. No previous iGEM team had extracted nanocellulose from lignocellulosic plant material rather than growing it bacterially.
summary_zh: NanoBrew 以啤酒糟（BSG）為原料——它以重量計約占啤酒釀造廢棄物的 85%，目前大多進入掩埋場或低價賣作動物飼料——改用酵素、而不是熱酸與高耗能的機械研磨來萃取奈米纖維素。團隊表現了一個 Bacillus subtilis 的木聚醣酶（XynA）以剝除半纖維素、把纖維素暴露出來，並表現一個經祖先序列重建的 Cel5A 內切葡聚醣酶、融合一個碳水化合物結合模組，把纖維素切到奈米纖絲尺度；他們在 E. coli 中測試了六種構築版本，分別帶與不帶 YebF 分泌標籤。此專題進入前十並獲簡報、創業與生物製造三項提名，因為整個專題從頭到尾被框成一個紐西蘭循環經濟的故事——建立在一段真實的釀酒廠合作關係上、紮根於毛利人的 kaitiakitanga（守護）價值，並附有完整的試量產廠成本分析與支持函——也因為團隊坦白承認自己始終沒能完成產品的特性分析。此前沒有任何 iGEM 隊伍從木質纖維素植物材料中萃取奈米纖維素，過去都是用細菌培養出來的。

dry.frameworks: Modest but purposeful, and honestly scoped. Before ordering genes, all six constructs were folded with AlphaFold 3 and the predicted structures aligned in PyMOL against the unfused enzymes to check the YebF tag, linkers and CBM had not disturbed the catalytic core - RMSD came out at 0.101 and 0.117 Angstrom for XynA and YebF-XynA, and 0.183, 0.155, 0.173 Angstrom for the endoglucanase variants, all well under 2 Angstrom, with pTM reported per model and the flexible linker correctly flagged as an unstructured region. Enzyme assays were run as time-series DNS and fitted to Michaelis-Menten-like behaviour on both the control substrate (birchwood xylan) and on BSG, with enzyme inactivation used to freeze each timepoint. For the system-level question they built a causal loop diagram with 12 nodes linking the environmental, economic and social effects of an upscaled process, signed each causal link positive or negative, and decomposed the graph into balancing and reinforcing loops - while explicitly refusing to quantify link strength. The microfluidic viscometer was designed entirely in simulation (Capillarix, an unreleased capillary-microfluidics simulator supplied by its creator) with a simulated error table, and the absorbance sensor uses a machine learning calibration running on the device itself.
dry.frameworks_zh: 規模不大但目的明確，而且範圍劃分誠實。在訂購基因之前，六個構築全部用 AlphaFold 3 折疊，並在 PyMOL 中把預測結構與未融合的酵素對位，檢查 YebF 標籤、連接子與 CBM 沒有擾動催化核心——XynA 與 YebF-XynA 的 RMSD 分別為 0.101 與 0.117 埃，內切葡聚醣酶的各版本為 0.183、0.155、0.173 埃，全都遠低於 2 埃，每個模型都報告 pTM 值，柔性連接子也正確標記為無序區域。酵素活性試驗以 DNS 法做時間序列，並在對照受質（樺木木聚醣）與 BSG 上都擬合近似 Michaelis-Menten 的行為，各時間點以酵素失活方式凍結。在系統層級的問題上，他們畫了一張含 12 個節點的因果迴圈圖，串起流程放大後的環境、經濟與社會效應，為每條因果連結標上正負號，並把圖分解成平衡迴圈與增強迴圈——同時明確表示拒絕量化連結強度。微流體黏度計完全在模擬中設計完成（Capillarix，一套由其作者提供、尚未釋出的毛細管微流體模擬器），並附一份模擬誤差表；吸光度感測器則採用一套在裝置上自行運行的機器學習校正。
dry.dataviz: The two devices are the visualization story: the project needed a way to read nanocellulose concentration from microlitre samples, and the engineering subteam built it. The differential microfluidic viscometer compares a sample against a reference fluid in a sealed channel to cancel out the variable hydrophilicity of PMMA, computing relative viscosity as the ratio of average length-times-velocity products over the first second of flow, then calibrating to the expected sample range so unknowns are read by linear interpolation. The optical sensor strobes red, green and blue LEDs sequentially and feeds the three absorbance values to a machine learning model on an onboard ESP32, which infers concentration - and is deliberately built so a biotechnologist can recalibrate it for whatever property they want to infer. The wiki itself keeps each page to a clear sectioned structure with a sidebar contents list, and the stakeholder work is presented as an influence-interest grid rather than a list.
dry.dataviz_zh: 兩個裝置本身就是視覺化的重點：這個專題需要一個能從微升級樣品讀出奈米纖維素濃度的方法，而工程分組把它做出來了。差動式微流體黏度計在密封流道中把樣品與參考流體相比，以抵銷 PMMA 親水性不穩定的影響，並以流動第一秒內「長度乘速度」乘積平均值的比值計算相對黏度，再對預期的樣品範圍校正，使未知樣品可用線性內插讀出。光學感測器依序閃爍紅、綠、藍 LED，把三個吸光度值餵給板載 ESP32 上的機器學習模型推論濃度——而且刻意設計成讓生物技術人員能重新校正，用來推論自己想要的任何性質。wiki 本身把每一頁維持在分節清楚的結構，並在側欄附目錄，利害關係人的工作也以影響力—關注度矩陣呈現、而不是列成清單。
dry.datascience: The dry lab's strongest quality is calibrated honesty rather than volume of computation. The team states plainly at the top of the entrepreneurship page that its market research targeted cellulose nanofibrils because that was the anticipated product from the literature, but that it was unable to characterise what it actually made; the FTIR comparison against a pure nanocellulose reference sample came back inconclusive, and they published that, named ATR-FTIR as the next attempt, and said they were waiting on expert advice as of the wiki freeze. For the absorbance sensor they ran out of nanocellulose and substituted guar gum, justifying it as shear-thinning with a similar concentration-opacity relationship, and tabulating the results as such. The viscometer error table notes that surface roughness is not modelled. They also report that only one student in their school talks had heard of iGEM, and that a 2019 survey of 9,000 New Zealanders found 30% opposed selling GM food at all - using measured baselines rather than assertions about public attitudes.
dry.datascience_zh: 乾實驗最強的品質不在運算量，而在校準過的誠實。團隊在創業頁面最上方直白說明，他們的市場研究是以纖維素奈米纖絲為標的，因為文獻預期的產物是它，但他們無法完成對實際做出來的東西的特性分析；與純奈米纖維素參考樣品的 FTIR 比對結果不明確，他們照實公開，點名 ATR-FTIR 是下一次的嘗試，並說明在 wiki 凍結時他們仍在等專家意見。吸光度感測器部分，他們的奈米纖維素用完了，改以關華豆膠替代，並以其同為剪切稀化、且濃度與不透明度關係相似為理由加以說明，表格也如實標示。黏度計的誤差表則註明表面粗糙度未納入模型。他們也報告在校內演講中只有一位學生聽過 iGEM，以及一份 2019 年對 9,000 位紐西蘭人的調查發現 30% 完全反對販售基改食品——用實測的基線、而不是對公眾態度的斷言。
dry.software: No standalone software release. The hardware is the deliverable: two sensors for reading nanocellulose concentration in microlitre volumes, one a differential capillary-microfluidics viscometer validated in simulation, the other a built RGB-strobing absorbance/turbidity sensor with on-ESP32 machine learning calibration, both developed through two documented iterations of the engineering design cycle and integrated into University of Canterbury engineering students' coursework with some of those students joining as external collaborators. Parts are the other contribution: six constructs registered, with EG-CBM (BBa_26TOG7XZ) highlighted as expressing and purifying extremely well with good activity on complex substrates, plus Pichia/yeast-targeted versions using an OST1 signal sequence and T2A self-cleaving peptide bicistronic designs (BBa_266IKFQ3, BBa_26OB3D76), and a characterisation of the YebF secretion tag (BBa_K1610300, from TAS_Taipei 2015) intended to let future teams choose a secretion system on evidence.
dry.software_zh: 沒有獨立的軟體發布。硬體才是交付成果：兩個用於在微升體積下讀取奈米纖維素濃度的感測器，一個是在模擬中驗證的差動毛細管微流體黏度計，另一個是已製作完成、以紅綠藍閃爍取光的吸光度／濁度感測器，並在 ESP32 上做機器學習校正；兩者都經過兩輪有完整紀錄的工程設計循環，並被整合進坎特伯里大學工程系學生的課程作業，其中部分學生還以外部協作者身分加入團隊。元件是另一項貢獻：註冊了六個構築，其中 EG-CBM（BBa_26TOG7XZ）被特別標示為表現與純化都極佳、且對複雜受質有良好活性，另有針對 Pichia／酵母的版本，採用 OST1 訊號序列與 T2A 自切胜肽的雙順反子設計（BBa_266IKFQ3、BBa_26OB3D76），以及對 YebF 分泌標籤（BBa_K1610300，來自 TAS_Taipei 2015）的特性分析，目的是讓未來的隊伍能依證據選擇分泌系統。
techniques: Structure prediction and RMSD alignment for fusion-construct validation
pTM / confidence-based interpretation of predicted models
Time-series DNS enzyme assay with Michaelis-Menten fitting
Causal loop diagramming with balancing and reinforcing loop decomposition
Multi-wavelength absorbance with on-device ML calibration

good.publicEngagement: Outreach was built around a deliberate hypothesis: in New Zealand, synthetic biology means genetic modification and genetic modification means risk, so the team tested whether a local story changes how people engage. They gave three secondary-school talks (one at Burnside High School, two at Christchurch Girls' High School, both schools some members had attended) covering synthetic biology, iGEM, what a science degree looks like and how NanoBrew works, and structured them for dialogue - long question time, small-group breakout discussion, a quiz where answers were argued through rather than marked, contact details left for follow-ups, and teacher feedback collected. Their findings are reported as findings: students already knew breweries and brewery waste so the local hook carried the science; small groups worked far better than whole-cohort presentation; most questions were about science careers and preparing for university, where undergraduates were better placed to answer than any teacher; and only one student had ever heard of iGEM. For the wider public they worked with the university communications team on a press release framed as a local problem with a local solution, which reached The Press, NZ Herald, Radio New Zealand, NewstalkZB, The Breeze, The Platform and deliberately rural and regional outlets including the Ashburton Courier and Selwyn Times, with a team member and the PI giving radio interviews that explained containment in plain language; the Instagram account passed 23,000 views. They also presented at the Biomolecular Interaction Centre Winter Symposium. The published lessons for future teams are practical: get your institution's comms team involved early, and contact schools months ahead because they plan a year out.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 科普工作圍繞一個刻意設定的假說展開：在紐西蘭，合成生物學等同於基因改造，而基因改造等同於風險，因此團隊檢驗了一個在地故事能否改變人們參與的方式。他們辦了三場中學演講（一場在 Burnside High School、兩場在 Christchurch Girls' High School，兩校都有成員就讀過），內容涵蓋合成生物學、iGEM、讀科學學位是什麼樣子，以及 NanoBrew 如何運作，並且是為對話而設計的——很長的問答時間、小組分組討論、一場答案要被辯論而不是被打分數的測驗、留下聯絡方式供後續提問，並收集教師意見。他們把發現當成發現來報告：學生本來就認識釀酒廠與釀酒廢棄物，所以在地切入點把科學帶動了起來；小組的效果遠好於對全體學生做簡報；大多數問題關於科學職涯與升大學的準備，而在這方面大學部學生比任何老師都更能回答；而且只有一位學生曾聽過 iGEM。對更廣的公眾，他們與校方傳播團隊合作發出一份以「在地問題、在地解法」為框架的新聞稿，觸及 The Press、NZ Herald、Radio New Zealand、NewstalkZB、The Breeze、The Platform，並刻意涵蓋鄉村與區域媒體，包括 Ashburton Courier 與 Selwyn Times；一位隊員與計畫主持人接受廣播訪問，用淺白語言說明生物圍堵；Instagram 帳號觀看數超過 23,000。他們也在生物分子交互作用中心的冬季研討會上發表。公開給未來隊伍的經驗很實際：及早讓學校的傳播團隊介入，並提早數個月聯絡學校，因為學校的規劃是以年為單位。
good.ihp: Human practices is organised around kaitiakitanga, the Maori concept of guardianship, with Bree Bell (Kaiarahi for UC Science) consulted early on how the project interfaces with iwi and hapu, and further consultation explicitly deferred to the scale-up stage rather than claimed as done. Stakeholders are mapped on an influence-interest grid and the design changes are specific. The team was split between on-site plants at each brewery and one centralised facility; Professor Jack Heinemann and Dr Brigitta Kurenbach, both involved in international synthetic biology regulation, argued that a distributed model multiplies accidental-exposure risk and regulatory burden because each site needs separate approval, so the team went centralised. The same pair identified the circular-economy rebound effect - if BSG becomes valuable, beer gets cheaper to make, production rises and total waste could increase - and told them 'sustainable' depends on timeframe and is often marketing; the team consequently narrowed its claim to reducing environmental impact relative to alternative BSG disposal, up to a stated horizon, and no further. Materially Kiwi (a startup making leather from kiwifruit waste) independently warned that customers buy on performance, consistency and price, not sustainability, and that a free feedstock does not mean a cheap product once collection, processing, testing and equipment are counted - which moved yield confirmation and full process costing to the top of the priority list. Dr Stefan Hill and Dr Mathias Sorieul at the Bioeconomy Science Institute warned that BSG-derived nanocellulose may be indistinguishable from wood-derived, so the low-cost waste feedstock, not the material, is the selling point; they also reframed BSG's high hemicellulose as a possible advantage, citing an Australian spinifex grass result where hemicellulose remnants improved material properties, and prescribed the three characterisation methods (SEM for fibril width, sedimentation for aspect ratio, FTIR for purity) the team then attempted. Dr Andrew Prest at Foodstuffs Own Brands listed what a packaging buyer needs and confirmed food-contact use would need substantial safety assessment, which is why the team targets non-food packaging first. Lincoln Agritech's suggestion of rheology as a measurement route is what started the viscometer, and Professor Volker Nock was met at the BIC symposium after researchers there raised the energy cost of freeze-thaw cycles at scale.
good.ihp_zh: 人類實踐以毛利人的守護概念 kaitiakitanga 為核心組織，並在早期就諮詢了 Bree Bell（坎特伯里大學理學院的 Kaiarahi），討論專題如何與 iwi（部族）與 hapū（氏族）接合，而更進一步的諮詢則明確留待放大階段、沒有宣稱已經完成。利害關係人以影響力—關注度矩陣繪製，設計上的改動也很具體。團隊原本在「每家釀酒廠設在地廠」與「集中一座設施」之間猶豫；Professor Jack Heinemann 與 Dr Brigitta Kurenbach（兩人都參與國際合成生物學法規工作）主張分散式模式會放大意外暴露的風險與法規負擔，因為每個場址都需要各自核准，於是團隊改走集中式。這兩位也指出了循環經濟的反彈效應——如果 BSG 變得有價值，釀啤酒的成本就降低、產量就上升，總廢棄量反而可能增加——並告訴他們「永續」取決於時間尺度、而且往往只是行銷語言；團隊因此把主張收斂為「相對於其他 BSG 處理方式可降低環境衝擊」，並明訂時間範圍，不再多說。Materially Kiwi（一家以奇異果廢料製作皮革的新創）則獨立提醒他們，客戶買的是性能、一致性與價格，不是永續性，而且一旦把收集、處理、檢測與設備都算進去，免費的原料並不等於便宜的產品——這把產率確認與完整流程成本推上了優先清單的最前面。生物經濟科學研究所的 Dr Stefan Hill 與 Dr Mathias Sorieul 警告，來自 BSG 的奈米纖維素可能與木材來源的無法區分，因此賣點是低成本的廢料原料、不是材料本身；他們也把 BSG 半纖維素含量高一事重新框成可能的優勢，引用一項澳洲 spinifex 草的結果，其中殘留的半纖維素改善了材料性質，並指定了三種特性分析方法（以 SEM 量纖絲寬度、以沉降法量長寬比、以 FTIR 驗純度），團隊隨後也照著嘗試。Foodstuffs Own Brands 的 Dr Andrew Prest 列出包材採購方的需求，並確認接觸食品的用途需要相當完整的安全性評估，這就是團隊先鎖定非食品包材的原因。Lincoln Agritech 建議以流變學作為量測途徑，正是黏度計的起點；而在生物分子交互作用中心研討會上，有研究者提出大規模冷凍—解凍循環的能耗問題之後，他們才見到 Professor Volker Nock。
good.realWorld: The commercial case is unusually complete for an undergraduate team and backed by two letters of support (Cassels Brewing Co. and Lincoln University). Local grounding: in Christchurch alone BSG accounts for an estimated 680-1,000 tonnes to landfill a year, costing breweries up to NZ$220,000 in disposal fees, and nationally roughly 13,700 tonnes to landfill producing 14,000 tonnes CO2-equivalent, which the promotional video renders as 3,300 petrol cars running for a year. Market: nanocellulose at US$947 million in 2026 growing at 23.74% CAGR to a projected US$6.4 billion by 2035, with the team noting that estimates vary between reports and stating which figure it uses throughout. Price reality from stakeholders sets the strategy: at around $100/kg nanocellulose suits high-value medical uses while broad uptake needs roughly $10/kg, so packaging is the entry market. The page carries a development roadmap, a commercial-scale cost forecast, a downloadable preliminary CNF cost analysis for a pilot-scale plant, financial analysis and timeline, a business exit strategy, minimum viable product definition, PEST, SWOT, risk and competitor analyses (including Nano-Sea/AgriSea making kelp-derived nanocellulose locally, which does not target packaging), and a pitch deck. On IP, the UC Technology Transfer Office told them a first filing runs NZ$10-15K and is only worth it if results look promising, that only novel elements need protecting, that much of their approach is already published so finding the novel element may be hard, and that they should BLAST their enzyme sequences against patented sequences to check freedom to operate - and that they should document negative results because that is how an invention's origin is evidenced. The team notes everything submitted to iGEM enters the public domain, so any filing had to precede the wiki. Continuation is real: the media coverage plus the results won University of Canterbury funding for a summer research project carrying the work on under Dr Kelsi Hall, one of only 18 scholarships awarded across all faculties in 2026. The team also commits to licensing the process to other agricultural and food-processing waste streams once protected, with documentation, stakeholder map and methods open now.
good.realWorld_zh: 這份商業論證對一支大學部隊伍而言完整度異常地高，並有兩封支持函支撐（Cassels Brewing Co. 與 Lincoln University）。在地立論：僅在基督城，BSG 估計每年就有 680 至 1,000 公噸進入掩埋場，使釀酒廠付出高達 22 萬紐幣的處理費；全國約 13,700 公噸進掩埋場、產生 14,000 公噸二氧化碳當量，宣傳影片把它換算成 3,300 輛汽油車跑一年。市場：奈米纖維素在 2026 年規模為 9.47 億美元，以 23.74% 的年複合成長率推估到 2035 年達 64 億美元，團隊並註明各份報告的估計值不一致，也說明自己全篇採用的是哪一個數字。利害關係人提供的價格現實決定了策略：在每公斤約 100 美元時奈米纖維素適合高值醫療用途，但要廣泛採用需要約每公斤 10 美元，因此包材是進入市場的切入點。該頁面附有開發路線圖、商業規模成本預測、一份可下載的試量產廠 CNF 初步成本分析、財務分析與時程、商業退場策略、最小可行產品定義、PEST、SWOT、風險與競品分析（包括在當地以海帶製作奈米纖維素、但不以包材為標的的 Nano-Sea/AgriSea），以及一份募資簡報。在智慧財產方面，坎特伯里大學技術移轉辦公室告訴他們首次申請要花 1 萬至 1.5 萬紐幣，只有在結果看來有潛力時才值得；只有新穎的部分需要保護；他們的做法有很大一部分已被發表，因此要找出新穎處可能很難；他們應該把自己的酵素序列對專利序列做 BLAST，以確認可實施性——而且應該記錄負面結果，因為那正是證明一項發明來源的方式。團隊也指出，凡提交給 iGEM 的內容都進入公共領域，因此任何申請都必須在 wiki 之前完成。延續是真的：媒體報導加上研究成果，為他們贏得坎特伯里大學的暑期研究計畫經費，由 Dr Kelsi Hall 指導把工作接續下去，而 2026 年全校各學院合計只核發 18 份這類獎助。團隊也承諾，在取得保護之後會把這套流程授權給其他農業與食品加工的廢料流，而文件、利害關係人地圖與方法現在就已公開。

gemsTakeaway: UCNZ shows how to publish an unfinished result well: they never characterised their nanocellulose, said so at the top of the page that depended on it, named the failed method (FTIR, inconclusive against a reference sample), the planned replacement (ATR-FTIR) and the substitute material they used when samples ran out - and still won Top 10. The second transferable move is the local hook: anchor the project in an industry students already recognise, then get the institution's communications office involved early enough that national and regional media carry the story, which is what converted their outreach into continuation funding.
gemsTakeaway_zh: UCNZ 示範了如何把一個未完成的結果好好發表：他們始終沒有完成奈米纖維素的特性分析，就把這點寫在最依賴它的那一頁最上方，點名失敗的方法（FTIR，與參考樣品比對後結果不明確）、計畫中的替代方法（ATR-FTIR），以及樣品用完時所用的替代材料——然後還是進了前十。第二項可移植的做法是在地切入點：把專題錨定在學生本來就認得的產業上，再及早讓校方的傳播室介入，讓全國與區域媒體把故事帶出去——這正是把他們的科普轉化為後續經費的關鍵。
